failedAssertions.reason: The end-to-end discovery flow is not reliably usable because navigating into /projects from the shell can strand the user on a broken client state before they can continue browsing.
Keyboard-first traversal is not reliable across major surfaces because the projects shell and case-study flow can lose interactive focusability due to client chunk failures.
Return-to-browsing navigation exists in the shell, but it currently leads users into a broken /projects client state instead of a dependable browsing surface.
Route-level error recovery currently strands the user on a generic application error instead of offering retry or return-to-projects navigation.

blockedAssertions.blockedBy: Blocked by the projects index runtime failure, so consistency across home, index, and route could not be fully proven through the visible product.

Blocked because the projects index crashed before its portfolio-level trust cue could be checked; home-to-route comparison looked honest, but the assigned cross-surface assertion could not be fully proven.

appliedUpdates.description: Recorded the current production-like chunk-load regression on /projects and noted that reliable shell navigation, keyboard traversal, and route-probe recovery assertions should fail or block until it is fixed.
